note: Requirement id -> the lane that proves it and the journey that shows it. A requirement with no lane is not delivered, whatever the code says.

requirements.statement: Email + password sign-up/sign-in with verification, magic-link, reset; sessions with device list and revoke; rate-limited auth endpoints.
Every user gets a personal tenant at sign-up; the active tenant is explicit in the URL and in the session.
Every user-facing string lives in one typed string table; no string literals in JSX except test ids and codes.
Numbers, dates, currency and units render only through SEAM-FORMAT with BD_DOCUMENT conventions.
Closed refusal taxonomy in src/core/errors.ts; the refusal register test covers it.
Tokens are CSS variables emitted from one TS source; both themes; no colour literal outside tokens.
Basis palette is fixed and each basis carries a glyph so it survives greyscale.
Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for every number with tabular-nums slashed-zero; the stated type scale.
Motion bands, no bounce, prefers-reduced-motion honoured everywhere.
Focus ring 2px cobalt, keyboard reachable, ARIA labelled, axe serious/critical = 0 on every screen.
A refusal is never a toast alone: code, message, remedy, in place.
First sign-in leads to creating a tenant; empty states teach the next action.
Every screen defines loading, empty, error, refusal states.
src/core/format.ts is the tree's sole caller of Intl; toLocaleString and localeCompare are lint errors; en-BD is banned.
forTenant / runAsSystem are the only database handles; RLS and tenant columns as backstop; three roles.
format.ts (L-FMT-01).
The Foundation increment delivers the complete toolchain surface in one reviewed unit.
The gate's own toolchain is born before the gate arms, in one increment.
Tenant slug and project URL scheme final form (/t/{slug}/p/{code}).
Refusal register: every code exercised by name or deferred by name; no orphan codes.
Live Postgres seam tests: RLS per table, cross-tenant refusal, migration ledger.
Builds once, seeds a scratch DB, runs Playwright journeys with traces, axe and visual baselines.
The machine's report: pins, Postgres, roles, ledger drift, ports, storage, env.
Sign in / sign up / magic link / reset / accept invitation. Minimal, branded, fast.

deferred.reason: Invite accept and tenant admin are J-002's increment; J-001's invite-accept leg arrives with it.
Density persistence needs the workspace shell; tokens are in place, the screens are not.
The left rail, top bar and inspector need screens this increment does not deliver.
Deep links to a sheet, register line or bid item need those screens; /t/{slug} is live and /t/{slug}/p/{code} is reserved.
The document seam (Typst, font coverage) is out of scope here; the code is registered with a written remedy.
